acceptanceCriteria.text: Reading an FR, TR, TEST or mapping through REST, the typed client or the REPL reports the creation and update times stored with that record. A read never reports the time of the read; when the store holds no time, the value is null (operator 2026-11-02: "This HAS to be fixed."; PR 87 slice P). A stored time written without an offset is read as UTC (operator 2026-11-02: "UTC"; pre-HV what-if finding: no contract row pinned it).

result.description:
The server shall support CRUD operations for Functional Requirements (FR), Technical Requirements (TR), Testing Requirements (TEST), and FR-to-TR mapping rows backed by the canonical project requirements Markdown files.

**Covered by:** `RequirementsController`, `RequirementsDocumentService`, `IRequirementsRepository`
result.title: Requirements Document CRUD Management
